Flag germline GENOTYPE cell when backed by a low-depth control sample (Generated by Claude Sonnet 5)

Source: R/render_table.R
render_genotype_style.Rd

Mirrors the DP_CONTROL-based flagging previously implemented via DT::formatStyle: variants with a real (non-sentinel), low control sequencing depth are marked with a colored left border and bold text, so that their genotype call is interpreted with appropriate caution. DP_CONTROL is set to -1 (sentinel) when CPSR is run without a matched control sample, in which case no styling is applied.

Usage

render_genotype_style(data, low_depth_threshold = 10)

Arguments

data

The main data frame (passed via closure)

low_depth_threshold

Sequencing depth (control sample) below which the GENOTYPE cell is flagged (default: 10)

Value

A function that can be used as a reactable cell style renderer for the GENOTYPE column of the germline findings table
